messages:
harper: want a single-sheet solution brief for enterprise buyers that folds security controls, SLA guarantees, and a short deploy-mode decision guide into one asset for webinar follow-up.
noah: yes — keep it scannable. header value prop, three sections: Security & Controls, SLA & Reliability, Deploy Mode Tradeoffs. each section 3 bullets + CTA.
ivy: security bullets should mention customer KMS support, HSM option, audit logs / SIEM hooks, and data residency. flag: legal must approve compliance wording.
sam: SLA bullets: target uptime (e.g., 99.9%), latency tiers for Dedicated, behavior on capacity constraints (fallback to hosted). include a mini flow: "if latency>SLO -> auto-failover -> notify SEs".
harper: include a conservative benchmark callout: "Provisional: 95th pct latency ~90ms on Dedicated for 8k ctx (KV warm). Estimated $0.50 / 1k tokens for typical assistant workload." add engineering signoff note.
noah: marketing ops: when someone downloads the one-sheet, create an inbound lead with tag `enterprise_brief_v1` and capture fields: account_size, compliance_needs, requested_feature. route logic below.
ops-bot: suggested routing pseudocode:
```
if lead.tag == "enterprise_brief_v1":
  if lead.account_size >= 1000000:
    route -> enterprise_AE_queue
  elif lead.compliance == true:
    route -> solutions_engineering
  else:
    route -> growth_AE_pool
```
ivy: add a 1-line ROI for finance buyers: "Predictable unit costs and lower infra ops vs self-hosting." keep numbers out until bench confirmed.
sam: add a short sales play box: 3 qualifying q's (data residency, peak QPS, auditors), 2 common objections + rebuttals. AEs should have a 30s script.
harper: webinar CTA: "Watch 30-min: Enterprise Deployment Patterns" + link to recording in final email. attach PDF + 3 micro-bench charts.
noah: timeline: draft copy by EOD Tue, design by Thu, ops to implement SFDC mapping by Fri. legal + infra signoff next week.
ivy: i'll draft security copy and legal note. sam: i'll chase infra for conservative bench numbers.
ops-bot: doc seeded: https://docs.google.com/document/d/example-enterprise-brief-draft (marketing,sales) :white_check_mark:
harper: great — i'll post draft in #marketing when ready and tag AE leads. :rocket:
